question: What sum will earn a simple interest of ₹480 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Percentage Interest** for 3 years = Rate × Time = 16% × 3 = 48%

Given that 48% of the **Principal** = ₹480

1% of the **Principal** = 480 ÷ 48 = 10

100% (**Total Sum**) = 10 × 100 = ₹1,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest** (SI) = ₹480

**Time** (T) = 3 years

**Rate of Interest** (R) = 16% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/991ea5d2d616b1a878b568a14925cad71822825be6d9757a1539eef1ead0c69a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 480 = (P × 16 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 480 = (P × 48) ÷ 100

⇒ P × 48 = 480 × 100

⇒ P = (480 × 100) ÷ 48

⇒ P = 10 × 100

⇒ P = 1,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount. The formula is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is **Principal**, R is **Rate**, and T is **Time**.

Total Amount Formula

The total amount (A) after T years is the sum of the principal and the interest earned: A = P + SI = P × (1 + RT/100).

Rate and Time Relation

If the rate of interest is given per month, the time must also be in months, or both must be converted to an **annual basis** for calculation consistency.
